footerHints.planning: Planning room: Send your plan draft to the teacher for feedback while you work. You can keep writing and save drafts afterwards.
footerHints.planningSent: The plan draft has been sent. If you change the plan, you can send an updated draft to the teacher.
footerHints.planningFeedback: Your teacher has responded to the plan. Adjust it and send a revised draft when you want new feedback.
footerHints.drafting: Writing room: Send a text draft to the teacher for feedback while you work. This is not the same as submitting the finished text.
footerHints.draftingSent: The text draft has been sent. You can keep writing and send an updated draft after changes.
footerHints.draftingFeedback: Your teacher has responded to the text draft. Keep working and send a revised draft when you are ready.
footerHints.revision: Control room: Send your checks and improvements to the teacher when you want to show what changed.
footerHints.revisionFeedback: Your teacher has responded. Use the control room to improve the text and send a revision.
footerHints.final: Submit only when the text is finished. Use Save draft while you are still working.
footerHints.finalSent: The text has been submitted. If your teacher has opened it for changes, you can update the submitted text.
footerHints.finalFeedback: Your teacher has responded to the finished product. Make changes and submit a revised text when you are ready.
footerHints.improvements: Your teacher has asked for improvements in this room. Send the improvements after you have made changes.
